records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales increased $38.8 million, or 41.5%, to $132.2 million for the three months ended March 31, 2022 as compared to $93.4 million in the same period in the prior year.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The $38.8 million increase in net sales was driven by $30.5 million due to volume, including refilling our trade inventory, and $8.3 million due to price and mix.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Interest expense relating to our Credit Facility decreased $0.3 million to interest expense of $0.6 million for the three months ended March 2022 as compared to an interest expense of $0.9 million for the same period in the prior year as a result of the New Loan Agreement discussed in Note 1.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Selling, general and administrative expenses ("SG&A") were $60.6 million for the three months ended March 31, 2022, compared to $46.0 million in the prior year period.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: For information regarding our consolidated operating results, financial condition, liquidity and cash flows for the three months ended March 31, 2021 as compared to the same period in 2020, refer to "Part I—Item 2.
